title: Medicine in an Age of Empires, 1500-1800
description: An introduction to the broad shifts in European medicine of the early modern period, a period that saw the extension of overseas empires and the emergence of medicine as a profession. The course offers a thematic and comparative look at the intertwined experiences of disease, empire, and global commerce that reshaped expectations of what medicine could or should do, for whom, and at what cost.
